purpose: Background artwork composed around the existing centered After Bells waitlist copy and form.

desktop.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: bespoke desktop background photograph for the existing AFTER BELLS opening-soon waitlist page. Deliver only the background artwork, no website/UI.
Input images: image 1 (collection-hero.webp) is a product identity reference for the exact three bottles and their labels, NOT a composition to copy. Image 2 (amber-hour-bottle.webp) is a close product reference for the exact crystal geometry and ornate gold cap. Preserve bottle identities.
Primary request: create a cinematic photorealistic quiet luxury perfume campaign background, wide landscape 16:10, ideally 2560 x 1600 pixels, designed around a CENTRAL column of live HTML copy and a signup form.
Scene/backdrop: very dark espresso-brown stone and patinated bronze doorway interior at evening, with shallow door reveals at the extreme outer edges. Warm amber grazing light falls only on the side walls and on a low dark walnut ledge across the bottom. The center recedes into deep warm darkness. Intimate and tactile, like a perfume house about to open its doors.
Composition is essential: the entire vertical CENTRAL 48% of the image (x=26% to x=74%, y=0 to y=87%) MUST be uninterrupted very dark warm brown negative space with almost no detail, no bottle, no visible seam, no bright beam or high contrast architecture. This is where the existing centered headline, description, form and perks will go. Keep the top central area dark for the wordmark. At far LEFT place the Amber Hour bottle, fully visible, centered at x=13%, standing from y=45% to y=84%. At far RIGHT place the Open Sky bottle at x=83%, y=49% to y=84%, and Iron Crown bottle slightly behind at x=95%, y=40% to y=79%. Never let any bottle intrude on x=26%-74%. Asymmetric depth, products form a restrained frame around empty center. Natural quiet shadows across the ledge. The bottom 10% falls gently into darkness for live footer links.
Products: exact heavy rectangular faceted clear glass perfume bottles from reference with bevelled shoulders, thick crystal bases, ornate square engraved gold caps with scrolling four-petal motif, brushed gold front plaques with thin black double-line borders. Amber Hour and Iron Crown have warm amber liquid, Open Sky almost colorless liquid, tiny irregular 24k gold leaf settled inside. Natural realistic scale and convincing glass refraction. Labels must say "AFTER BELLS" and respectively "AMBER HOUR", "OPEN SKY", "IRON CROWN", as in reference, no extra text.
Lighting/mood: carefully exposed cinematic low key still-life; bottles remain clearly recognizable with elegant fine warm-gold edge highlights and engraved caps, but never bright white. Deep espresso shadows, burnished gold, warm amber, dark walnut. The empty center is deep #18110d with subtle material tonality. Photograph at eye-level, 50mm lens, crisp real materials, restrained natural reflections.
Constraints: background only; no headline, typography outside product labels, no browser chrome, no logo floating above scene, no graphic symbols, no watermark. No people, flowers, fabric curtain, smoke, glitter, stars, bokeh, saturated orange flood or fantasy palace. Do not fill the deliberately empty middle. Do not redesign the reference products.

mobile.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: bespoke MOBILE portrait background for the existing AFTER BELLS opening-soon waitlist page. Background photograph only, no website screenshot, no UI. 9:16 portrait composition, ideally 1440 x 2560.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved wide desktop campaign background, use it as the exact visual-world reference: dark espresso doorway, dark walnut ledge, amber grazing light, three faceted glass perfume bottles with engraved square gold caps. Image 2 is the product identity reference, use the same exact three bottles, colors and labels.
Primary request: art-direct a companion portrait background specifically for a phone screen with a very tall centered headline and form occupying almost the whole canvas. Preserve the wide image's restrained photorealistic low-key look, gold, espresso, amber and natural materials.
Composition: upper 70% of the ENTIRE portrait is almost entirely empty deep espresso-black (#18110d) with subtly tactile dark stone; NO product or bright light behind the central copy. Thin bronze architectural edges are barely visible only at the extreme left and right margins, dim amber light grazing the outermost 5% of the image. All three perfume bottles are grouped as a VERY SMALL, tasteful, low-contrast still life at the BOTTOM, from y=76% to y=94%, on a dark walnut ledge: Amber Hour left, Open Sky slightly forward center, Iron Crown right. The three together span x=19% to x=81%. Their caps start no higher than y=76%; they must be small, leaving generous open dark space above. The very bottom 6% becomes dark for footer copy. Soft amber reflections across the low ledge. Do not enlarge the bottles.
Exact products: rectangular faceted heavy glass with bevelled shoulders and thick clear bases, square ornate gold caps engraved with scrolling four-petal motif; brushed gold double-bordered plaques. Amber Hour and Iron Crown contain amber perfume, Open Sky is nearly colorless. Tiny irregular real gold-leaf fragments settled inside. Preserve reference labels "AFTER BELLS" and "AMBER HOUR", "OPEN SKY", "IRON CROWN", no additional writing.
Lighting: low-key dark campaign photography. The products are softly lit with restrained warm gold edge highlights, kept darker than the desktop image so live text can pass over this mobile background. Subtle local amber glow at bottom sides only. Center and top stay consistently dark. Crisp real glass, real metal, no plastic look. Photographed at eye level.
Constraints: only background artwork. No live-site headline, wordmark at top, UI, text overlay, watermark, people, flowers, smoke, glitter, bright center, central seam, bright architecture, large bottle at center, floating bottles. Preserve the huge quiet upper 70%.
